5. SLA Credits
If actual monthly uptime falls below the 99.9% commitment in Section 2, affected customers receive a
service credit automatically applied to their next invoice -- no request or ticket is required. Credits are
tiered: 10% of that month's subscription fee for uptime between 99.0% and 99.9%, and 25% of that
month's subscription fee for uptime below 99.0%. Credits are calculated only against unscheduled
downtime; time within an announced maintenance window (Section 8) never counts against the uptime
commitment and therefore never generates a credit.
6. Data Backup & Retention
Customer data is backed up automatically once per day. Daily backups are retained for 30 days, after
which they are permanently deleted. Point-in-time recovery is available for any moment within the
preceding 7 days. In the event of a full regional outage, Vellumiq's disaster recovery plan targets a Recovery
Time Objective (RTO) of 4 hours and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 1 hour, meaning up to 1 hour of
the most recent data could be lost in a worst-case disaster recovery scenario.

9. Contacting Support
Bronze and Silver tier customers can reach support by email at support@vellumiqcloud.example or through
the in-app chat widget. Gold and Platinum tier customers additionally have access to phone support.
Platinum tier customers are assigned a dedicated shared Slack channel with their account team for
real-time communication.
